questions.question: Dr Sami must extract an impacted mandibular wisdom tooth. Dr Mina reminds him of the Pell and Gregory classification. Which classification is the most unfavorable?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Class III with position C is the most unfavorable. The tooth is deeply impacted with a high risk of injury to the inferior alveolar nerve.' Dr Sami: 'I'll be careful.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an extraction of a buried residual root. Dr Sami asks her which instrument is the most suitable. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The Luxator is ideal for buried roots because its thin blade allows sectioning the periodontal ligament without bone trauma.' Dr Sami: 'I'll get one for myself.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a maxillary wisdom tooth with a suspected sinus communication. Dr Mina advises him to check a clinical sign. What is this sign?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The Valsalva maneuver allows visualizing the passage of air through the socket, confirming the sinus communication.' Dr Sami: 'I'll perform it.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform a flap to access an impacted tooth. Dr Sami asks her which incision is the most appropriate. She chooses:
options: An intrasulcular incision with a mesial release incision
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The intrasulcular incision with mesial release offers optimal access for impacted teeth.' Dr Sami: 'I'll assist you.'

questions.question: Dr Sami has extracted a tooth with a vertical root fracture. Dr Mina asks him to check a crucial element. What is this element?
options: The integrity of the socket and the absence of fragments
The presence of a residual cyst
The condition of the adjacent tooth
The mobility of the bone table
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'After a root fracture, it is necessary to ensure that no fragment remains in the socket.' Dr Sami: 'I always check now.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must manage a persistent post-extraction hemorrhage. Dr Sami asks her which hemostatic agent is the most effective. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Oxidized regenerated cellulose is the hemostatic agent of choice for persistent hemorrhages.' Dr Sami: 'I'll get some for my practice.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a tooth with a hooked root. Dr Mina advises him on a specific technique. What is this technique?
options: The use of a curved elevator
The use of a bayonet forceps
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Root sectioning facilitates the extraction of a hooked root.' Dr Sami: 'I'll follow your advice.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an osteotomy to extract an impacted tooth. Dr Sami asks her the depth of the bone incision. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The osteotomy must be performed up to the root surface to free the tooth without weakening the bone.' Dr Sami: 'I'll be precise.'

questions.question: Dr Sami has performed an extraction and a dry socket has developed. Dr Mina asks him what the first-line treatment is. He answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Irrigation and socket dressing are the first-line treatment for dry socket.' Dr Sami: 'I'll follow the protocol.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must choose a type of suture for a flap. Dr Sami asks her which thread is the most suitable. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Resorbable thread is recommended for flaps because it avoids a second intervention.' Dr Sami: 'I'll use Vicryl.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a tooth with an associated cystic lesion. Dr Mina reminds him of an important precaution. What is this precaution?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Complete cystectomy is essential to prevent cyst recurrence.' Dr Sami: 'I'll be meticulous.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an extraction on a patient on anticoagulants. Dr Sami asks her for the management. She answers:
options: Maintain the treatment and reinforce local hemostasis
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Current recommendations favor maintaining anticoagulants with rigorous local hemostasis.' Dr Sami: 'I'll follow this protocol.'

questions.question: Dr Sami has extracted a tooth and the patient presents significant swelling. Dr Mina asks him to look for a warning sign. What is this sign?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Dyspnea is a warning sign that may indicate extension of the infection to deep spaces.' Dr Sami: 'I'll monitor this sign.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an excision of a mucosal lesion. Dr Sami asks her what safety margin to respect. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The safety margin for a mucosal lesion is 2 to 3 mm.' Dr Sami: 'I'll respect this rule.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a tooth with divergent roots. Dr Mina advises him on a technique. What is this technique?
options: The use of a straight elevator
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Root sectioning is recommended for teeth with divergent roots.' Dr Sami: 'I'll follow your advice.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must manage a patient with a penicillin allergy. Dr Sami asks her for the substitute antibiotic. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Clindamycin is the recommended substitute antibiotic in case of penicillin allergy.' Dr Sami: 'I'll remember this information.'

questions.question: Dr Sami has performed an extraction and the patient presents significant bleeding. Dr Mina asks him the first measure to take. He answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Compression with gauze is the first measure to take in case of bleeding.' Dr Sami: 'I'll start with that.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform a biopsy of a mucosal lesion. Dr Sami asks her what type of biopsy to perform. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Excisional biopsy is recommended for small mucosal lesions.' Dr Sami: 'I'll let you do it.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a tooth with a fractured crown. Dr Mina asks him the most suitable instrument. He answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The Luxator is ideal for fractured crowns because it allows sectioning the periodontal ligament.' Dr Sami: 'I'll use it.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an extraction with an atraumatic technique. Dr Sami asks her the objective of this technique. She answers:
options: Preserve as much alveolar bone as possible
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'The atraumatic technique aims to preserve as much alveolar bone as possible for implant placement.' Dr Sami: 'I'll practice it.'

questions.question: Dr Sami has extracted a tooth and the patient presents intense postoperative pain. Dr Mina asks him the most likely cause. He answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Dry socket is the most frequent cause of intense postoperative pain.' Dr Sami: 'I'll treat it.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform a suture in case of a flap. Dr Sami asks her the most suitable type of suture. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Mattress suture is recommended for flaps because it ensures good edge eversion.' Dr Sami: 'I'll practice it.'

questions.question: Dr Sami must extract a wisdom tooth with a risk of injury to the inferior alveolar nerve. Dr Mina asks him to perform an additional examination. What is this examination?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'CBCT allows precise evaluation of the relationship between the tooth and the inferior alveolar nerve.' Dr Sami: 'I'll prescribe it.'

questions.question: Dr Mina must perform an extraction on a diabetic patient. Dr Sami asks her for the precautions to take. She answers:
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Glycemic control and antibiotic prophylaxis are essential in diabetic patients.' Dr Sami: 'I'll follow this protocol.'

questions.question: Dr Sami, after performing several complex extractions, receives congratulations from Dr Mina. What is the next step for Dr Sami?
questions.explanation: Dr Mina explains: 'Specializing in advanced surgery is the next step to continue progressing.' Dr Sami: 'I'll get trained.'
